0022600039.text: The Houston Rockets, 9-3 and riding a two-game winning streak, host the 1-11 Utah Jazz in their 13th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group A matchup. Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture). This is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season, and Houston won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 140-106 win in Houston on April 3, 2026.
